scorchbeast.lead: When one of your claimed workshops is attacked, there is a 10% chance it is a Scorchbeast attack instead of a normal one. The workshop must be level 30 or higher. How many Scorchbeasts come depends on the workshop's level, and a workshop's level stays inside its region's level range.
